title: The Cruise Ship That Sailed Too Close to Shore

lines: A giant cruise ship struck a rock off the Italian island of Giglio.
It flooded and rolled onto its side, and thirty two people died.
The ship had left its route to sail close to the island.
A rock tore a long gash in the hull.
Water flooded the engine rooms, and power failed.
The order to evacuate came very late.
By then, the list made many lifeboats hard to use.
Cruise routes and evacuation rules were tightened afterward.
